# Sys1

> Sys1 helps coding agents review changes against your repository's rules, with probability-scored answers from hosted Jev, a local model, or your own server.

Install the `sys1-review` project skill for Codex, Claude Code, or Devin to preview Git changes, run reusable rules, investigate candidates, and record feedback. The independent `sys1-verify` project skill runs `sys1 verify` to compare an agent's completion message with reachable Git, pull-request, and page evidence. Install it with `sys1 verify setup codex`, `claude-code`, or `devin`. Both commands are experimental and advisory: model scores are not calibrated defect probabilities, and missing evidence does not prove completion.

Jev is TypeSafe's hosted decision model. Sys1 uses its System One API and also supports experimental local Qwen models or compatible HTTP servers. Hosted Jev requires explicit activation and an environment credential; selected source or message context goes to the selected backend. The same yes/no, choice, and score API is available through a Node or Bun client, an embedded Bun router, or a loopback HTTP daemon. Sys1 is MIT licensed.

Latest release: v0.17.0.

## Start with an agent workflow

- [Agent skills](https://sys1.io/skills): Choose project review instructions, completion checks, or a separate compact-output skill.
- [Getting started](https://sys1.io/docs#getting-started): Install Sys1 and choose hosted Jev or a local model.
- [Agent review](https://sys1.io/docs#audit): Install the project skill, preview selected changes, and investigate findings.
- [Review guide](https://github.com/hraness/sys1/blob/main/docs/review.md): Configure Codex, Claude Code, or Devin, record feedback, and write repository rules.
- [Verify completion claims](https://sys1.io/docs#verify): Pass a message from any agent; Devin also supports local transcript discovery.
- [Verify command](https://github.com/hraness/sys1/blob/main/docs/verify.md): Evidence sources, preview mode, privacy, and exit codes.

## Build with the decision API

- [Integration modes](https://sys1.io/docs#integration): Use the Node or Bun client, embedded Bun router, or local HTTP daemon.
- [Backends and models](https://sys1.io/docs#backends): Hosted Jev, local models, and compatible servers.
- [Profiles and tuning](https://sys1.io/docs#profiles): Reuse fixed questions and a model route with changing state.
- [Evaluations](https://sys1.io/docs/evaluations): Dated adapter reports with their workloads and limitations.
- [Compare models](https://sys1.io/compare): External JevBench results and workload cost.

## Separate compact-output skill

- [system-one-verify](https://sys1.io/skills#shipped): Run a known noisy test or build once, return a short result, and retain its full local log. It belongs to System One Skills, needs no Sys1 backend, and is different from `sys1 verify`.

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/hraness/sys1): Source, releases, and the endpoint reference in the README.
